privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: HANIN protects the personal information and technical documents you provide through the website.

collect.title: Information Collected
collect.p1: Full name, email, phone number, company name and request content when you submit a quote form, contact form or job application.
collect.p2: Attachments (CAD drawings, application documents) that you upload yourself.

purpose.title: Purpose of Use
purpose.p1: To respond to quote requests, provide technical advice, process job applications and improve service quality. HANIN does not sell or share information with third parties for commercial purposes.

security.title: Technical Document Security
security.p1: Drawings and attachments are stored in a private area, are not publicly accessible and can be viewed only by authorized staff.

retention.title: Retention Period and Your Rights
retention.p1: Information is kept for as long as needed to handle the request. You have the right to ask to view, correct or delete your information by contacting HANIN.

contact.title: Contact
contact.p1: For any questions about this policy, please email huyvinh82@gmail.com or call {phones}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By accessing and using this website, you agree to the terms below.

scope.title: Website Scope
scope.p1: The website presents capabilities and contract plating services and accepts quote requests. Information on the website is for reference and may change without notice.

quote.title: Request a Quote
quote.p1: A quote is valid only when confirmed in writing by HANIN. Technical specifications, schedule and final price depend on the drawings, materials and actual volume.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.p1: Content, images and trademarks on the website belong to HANIN. Drawings and documents you send remain your property and are used only to fulfill your request.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.p1: HANIN updates information to keep it accurate, but is not liable for damages arising from using information on the website without official confirmation.

contact.title: Contact
contact.p1: For questions about these terms, please contact huyvinh82@gmail.com.
